Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the gathered data and drew a logically inconsistent conclusion. Despite earlier noting Henry Scheffé’s lifespan as 70 years (1907–1977) versus Csaba Pálinkás’s 45 years (1959–2004), the Planner concluded that Csaba lived longer, apparently using the later death year as a proxy for lifespan. This erroneous comparison of death years instead of lifespans led to reversing the correct answer.
